metadata.title: R40 research archive: code, results and journal maps for "Support-Aware Terrain Threshold Decisions: Cross-Regional Evaluation and a Kazakhstan Mountain-Tourism Application"

creators.name: Sovetkali, Orazaly
creators.affiliation: CONFIRM (not stated in the reviewed manuscript text)

metadata.description:
Reproducible research archive for the manuscript on support-aware BELOW / ABOVE / ABSTAIN slope-threshold decisions prepared for Earth Science Informatics. Contents: source code and workflows (git history bundle and snapshots), stored result tables (leave-one-site-out and leave-one-country-out AURC, paired block bootstrap, ICESat-2 ATL08 risk-coverage), derived 30 m rasters and vector layers for Davos-Parsenn, Zermatt-Gornergrat (Switzerland), Alta-Snowbird, Park City (United States) and Medeu, Shymbulak, Kok-Zhailau (Kazakhstan), journal figures A-E (PNG 300 dpi, PDF, SVG) with captions, a file manifest with SHA-256 checksums, and licence and reproducibility reports.

Limitations. Kazakhstan has no independent lidar terrain model; the Kazakhstan maps show transferred classifications and error is not measured there. ICESat-2 ATL08 provides along-track samples only. Resort outlines are exploratory (OpenStreetMap or derived footprints), not official boundaries. ALOS AW3D30 and FABDEM rasters and KazEOSat imagery are not redistributed.
